repositoryCapabilities.residualBoundary: Local presentation owners are canonical; this says nothing about production deployment quality.
Active SQLite is not application-encrypted and is not a distributed database.
Per-tenant SQLite/filesystem isolation does not prove horizontal-scale or RLS deployment.
Protocol/quarantine are proven; scanner engine efficacy is external evidence.
Upstream IdP, MFA, deprovisioning and proxy administration are deployment evidence.
Restore anti-resurrection across external backup systems remains a deployment policy.
KMS/HSM custody, off-host durability and approved RTO/RPO are external evidence.
Collector, distributed tracing, alert routing and distributed rate limiting are deployment concerns.
The shared worklist owns interaction grammar while procedure-local providers own business semantics; it creates no global business status.

Native AR review-needed is derived from typed temporal/basis causes without rewriting prior approval; current material writes declare epistemic effects while action-name fallback remains bounded to legacy compatibility paths.

Repository-bounded reliability does not prove HA, a distributed queue/database, backend migration readiness, approved RTO/RPO, production capacity, production SLO/alert effectiveness or enterprise-ready status.
Exact build/runtime identity and browser observation are repository-bounded; they do not attest deployment provenance or production observability.
Procedure-local presentation and typed targeting are proven on the current repository runtime; human comprehension remains E4.
Owner-declared editorial order is repository-proven; it does not imply that every future local composition is usable without regression testing.
MC, EP and Proof specialized grammar is proven for current journeys; it does not create a universal card or legal/compliance conclusion.
Admin endpoint failure isolation and local retry are repository-proven; availability and upstream root-cause attribution remain deployment concerns.
Automated final-DOM keyboard/focus/reflow/motion/contrast/target-size effects are repository-proven; human AT effectiveness and usability remain independent E4 evidence.
